items.description: AI SDK is a TypeScript toolkit for building AI applications and agents, aimed at JavaScript and TypeScript developers; common uses are generating text and structured data, building agents and chat interfaces, and integrating language model providers.
llms.txt documentation index listing all AI SDK docs pages
sitemap.md: a semantic overview of all documentation
agents.md: agent-facing discovery file describing the API and MCP surfaces
AI SDK Core overview, covering the core functions generateText and streamText, structured data and tool usage
AI SDK UI overview, covering framework-agnostic hooks (useChat, useCompletion, useObject) and framework support
Agents overview, covering the ToolLoopAgent and HarnessAgent classes, workflows and agent frameworks
Tools and tool calling guide, covering multi-step calls with stopWhen, tool approval, dynamic tools and tool call repair
MCP tools guide, covering MCP client initialization, HTTP/SSE/stdio transports, OAuth, resources, prompts and elicitation
AI SDK RSC overview: React Server Components API (streamUI, createAI, useUIState, useAIState); there is a separate guide for migrating from RSC to AI SDK UI
Provider pages for individual model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, AI Gateway, etc.) plus OpenAI-compatible and community providers
Advanced topic guides (backpressure, caching, stopping streams, Vercel deployment, rate limiting, secure URL fetching, model as router)
Vercel AI Gateway is the default global provider, so models can be selected by string (e.g. "anthropic/..."); AI SDK UI supports React, Svelte, Vue.js, Angular and SolidJS (community).

On Vercel, request cancellation is supported only in the Node.js runtime and must be enabled per function with supportsCancellation in vercel.json; without it, stop() closes the client stream but does not cancel the function or model request.
